capabilities: insert Nyan Cat progress bars via slash commands
set progress as a percentage from 0 to 100
compute progress automatically from checked checkboxes
extras: README credits a hotfix contributor (@Eazlewing) for auto-update; documentation is minimal, covering only the two slash commands.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display a fun visual progress bar in a note, whether manual or derived from task checkboxes.
summary: Progress bar generator that inserts Nyan Cat themed progress bars into notes via slash commands, with automatic calculation from checked checkboxes.
